title: Bepul sinov: 7 kun
hero: Nigora (29, buxgalter, yumaloq ko'zoynak, to'q qizil kardigan, sochi turmaklangan) + eri Ulug'bek (32, soqolli, to'q ko'k futbolka) + dugonasi Shahzoda (28, kalta soch, sariq ko'ylak)
facts: C+R Research 2022: odamlar obunaga oyiga $86 to'layman deb o'ylagan, aslida $219 — $133 farq (crresearch.com, CNBC)
caption:
«Yetti kun bepul» deb bosgan edim — 3 oydan beri pul to'layapman 💳😅

Sizda nechta unutilgan obuna bor? 👇

#99foiz #obuna #pul #telefon #ilova #ozbekcha #uzbekistan #reels

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [curious] Siz hayotingizda nechta narsaga «bepul» deb obuna bo'lgansiz? Nigora — bitta deb o'ylaydi.
scenes.text: Siz hayotingizda nechta narsaga «bepul» deb obuna bo'lgansiz? Nigora — bitta deb o'ylaydi.
scenes.frames: Nigora on couch with phone, big glowing FREE-TRIAL button on screen (no text); close-up her confident smile

scenes.speaker: zilola
scenes.tts: [excited] Yetti kun bepul! Kino, musiqa, kitoblar... Bekor qilishni unutmayman, men buxgalterman-ku!
scenes.text: Yetti kun bepul! Kino, musiqa, kitoblar... Bekor qilishni unutmayman, men buxgalterman-ku!
scenes.frames: Nigora tapping phone excitedly; montage of streaming, music, books icons floating (no letters); she winks

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: Yetti kun o'tdi. Keyin bir oy. Keyin uch oy.
scenes.text: Yetti kun o'tdi. Keyin bir oy. Keyin uch oy.
scenes.frames: calendar pages flying; Nigora asleep with phone; bank card in a wallet being charged, coins flying away

scenes.speaker: sardor
scenes.tts: [confused] Nigora, kartadan har oy bir xil kunda pul yechilyapti. Bu «Premium Plyus Gold» kim o'zi?
scenes.text: Nigora, kartadan har oy bir xil kunda pul yechilyapti. Bu «Premium Plyus Gold» kim o'zi?
scenes.frames: husband Ulug'bek at kitchen table holding bank statement on a tablet, raised eyebrow; close-up statement

scenes.speaker: zilola
scenes.frames: Nigora nervous grin, sweat drop, hiding phone behind back

scenes.speaker: sardor
scenes.tts: [sarcastic] Har oy kartani ko'rganimda asabim chiqyapti-ku!
scenes.text: Har oy kartani ko'rganimda asabim chiqyapti-ku!

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: Nigora yolg'iz emas. Ikki ming yigirma ikkinchi yilda Amerikada so'rov o'tkazildi: odamlar obunalarga oyiga sakson olti dollar to'layman deb o'ylagan. Hisoblaganda esa — ikki yuz o'n to'qqiz dollar chiqqan!
scenes.text: Nigora yolg'iz emas. Ikki ming yigirma ikkinchi yilda Amerikada so'rov o'tkazildi: odamlar obunalarga oyiga sakson olti dollar to'layman deb o'ylagan. Hisoblaganda esa — ikki yuz o'n to'qqiz dollar chiqqan!
scenes.frames: infographic scene; people with calculators shocked; receipts long like a scroll

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: Ya'ni har oy bir yuz o'ttiz uch dollar o'zlari bilmagan holda ketib turgan.
scenes.text: Ya'ni har oy bir yuz o'ttiz uch dollar o'zlari bilmagan holda ketib turgan.
scenes.frames: money leaking from a phone like a dripping tap; small coins drain

scenes.speaker: dilnoza
scenes.tts: [laughs] Nigora, mening usulim bor: bepul sinovga yozilgan kunning o'zidayoq bekor qilaman. Ko'p ilovalarda yetti kun baribir ishlab turaveradi!
scenes.text: Nigora, mening usulim bor: bepul sinovga yozilgan kunning o'zidayoq bekor qilaman. Ko'p ilovalarda yetti kun baribir ishlab turaveradi!
scenes.frames: friend Shahzoda at cafe explaining with finger raised, Nigora taking notes

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: O'sha kecha Nigora obunalar ro'yxatini ochdi va o'n bitta obuna topdi. Ulardan biri — o'zi unutgan «buxgalteriya kursi».
scenes.text: O'sha kecha Nigora obunalar ro'yxatini ochdi va o'n bitta obuna topdi. Ulardan biri — o'zi unutgan «buxgalteriya kursi».
scenes.frames: Nigora at night scrolling long list on phone, shocked face lit by screen; close-up stunned eyes

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: Siz oxirgi marta obunalaringizni qachon tekshirgansiz? Hozir oching va izohda yozing: nechta chiqdi?
scenes.text: Siz oxirgi marta obunalaringizni qachon tekshirgansiz? Hozir oching va izohda yozing: nechta chiqdi?
